name: Chef au cercle de mémoire
description: A massive tall elder chief with warm grey skin, dense black mottling, a wide domed head and long black-white dreadlocks falling evenly down his back. Burgundy and ivory layered robes, heavy circular bronze gorget, carved bone belt with three oval plaques and broad bronze ankle guards. In his right hand a small open ring-shaped clan emblem at chest level, left hand gently closed near hip. Calm stately three-quarter stance.

All four must read clearly, slightly parted in a calm expression, attached outside the inner mouth. The face turns three-quarter toward viewer so both sides of the mandible structure are visible while body angles screen-right. Use a slight elevated orthographic three-quarter view, body angled screen-right and face near-front three-quarter so all four mandibles are visible. Preserve believable Predator/Yautja species anatomy, not a human face. This is a non-combat ceremonial leader, no attack pose.
